planets.name: TOI-122 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-122 with a 5.08-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-122 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-122. Its orbit and size follow Waalkes et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.
